meta.scope: Philippines Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. National statistical system (PSA), population census/estimates, national accounts, key labour and price series, central-bank macro anchors, and first structural uniqueness markers.
meta.population_note: PSA 2024 Census of Population: 112,729,484. Projections indicate continued growth toward ~124 million by 2035.

candidates.title: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office created by the Philippine Statistical Act of 2013 (merger of NSO, NSCB, BLES, BAS). Produces censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, poverty and multi-domain statistics. Attached to NEDA for policy coordination.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the entire Philippine statistical system.

candidates.title: Census of Population (and related mid-year estimates)
candidates.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. 2024 Census recorded 112,729,484 persons. Provides the demographic base for all per-capita and planning indicators.
candidates.notes: Core demographic node. Population ~112.7 million (2024 Census).

candidates.title: National Accounts of the Philippines (GDP / GRDP)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure) and Gross Regional Domestic Product. Central macro-output series.
referenced_by: BSP Monetary Policy Report and economic assessments

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates by major commodity group and region. High-frequency price signal used in monetary policy and welfare analysis.
referenced_by: BSP inflation targeting and Monetary Policy Report

candidates.title: Labor Force Survey (LFS)
candidates.description: Quarterly (and more frequent) labour-force statistics: employment, unemployment, underemployment, labour-force participation. Central labour-market barometer.

candidates.title: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, external accounts and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes the Monetary Policy Report, Balance of Payments, International Reserves and related series.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
candidates.description: Quarterly BOP and related external-sector accounts, including the large role of remittances (OFW) in the current account.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node with strong remittance linkage — a defining Philippine feature.

candidates.title: Gross International Reserves
candidates.description: Monthly official reserve assets. Key external-buffer indicator expressed in months of import cover.

candidates.title: Official poverty statistics (and related thresholds)
candidates.description: Official poverty incidence, poverty thresholds and related indicators derived from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) and other sources. High policy salience.

candidates.title: Philippines foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA and BSP sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the PSA institutional core, population census, national accounts, CPI, Labor Force Survey, BSP institutional role, BOP, international reserves and official poverty statistics into the opening foundation layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Philippine research.
